name: manual_d25737
claim: A loop that rewrites the MetaResearcher seat is purely optional. It starts only after a human approval at the top-level orchestrator gate. It never starts automatically. The experimental tri-level report found no reliable task gain over bi-level, so bi-level remains the default.

decisions.notes: Operator rule 2026-11-14. The tri-level report found no reliable gain, and a self-starting rewrite of the outer seat is refused.

rationale: Operator rule 2026-11-14. The tri-level report found no reliable gain, and a self-starting rewrite of the outer seat is refused.
